{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify QA rows: revenue = 999,999.99
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999,999.99'
print(f"Number of QA rows: {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Remove QA rows
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Now clean revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
# First, check if any non-comma values have commas
has_commas = df_clean['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
if has_commas.any():
    df_clean['revenue_clean'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
else:
    df_clean['revenue_clean'] = df_clean['revenue'].astype(float)

# Confirm the cleaning
print(f"Shape after removing QA rows: {df_clean.shape}")
print(f"First few cleaned revenue values:")
print(df_clean['revenue_clean'].head())"}
